note: OYL-006 is British Ale I (historic London brewery top-cropper), not Voss Kveik. Voss Kveik is OYL-061. Confirmed on the 2022 Probrew and 2024 Homebrew strain posters and the British Ale I product page.
OYL-013 is British Ale VI. London Ale is OYL-003 (which our dataset already has correctly). Confirmed on the British Ale VI product page and 2022 Probrew poster.
OYL-030 is Wit (a Belgian-style witbier ale strain), not Tropical IPA. Tropical IPA is OYL-200. Type is ale (Belgian ale), not wheat. Confirmed on the Wit product page and 2022/2024 posters.
OYL-041 is CL-50 Ale (a neutral, big-body, well-attenuating strain). DIPA Ale (Conan) is OYL-052. Confirmed via the 2018 Probrew strain list and the omegayeast.com CL-50 Ale portfolio page.

OYL-052 is DIPA Ale, the strong fermenter popularly called 'Conan'. HotHead is OYL-057. Our OYL-052 and OYL-057 names are swapped. Confirmed on 2022/2024 posters and Omega search results for HotHead (OYL-057).
OYL-057 is HotHead Kveik (Norwegian ale strain, honey/overripe-mango), not 'Wallonian Farmhouse'. Type is correct (kveik) but the name is wrong. Confirmed on the Hothead Kveik product page.
OYL-061 is Voss Kveik (Gjernes farmstead, orange-citrus). Lutra Kveik is OYL-071 (liquid), which our dataset already has correctly. Confirmed on the Voss Kveik product page and 2022/2024 posters.
OYL-101 is Pilsner I (Czech H-strain Pilsen lager). Saisonstein is OYL-500 (an ale), which our dataset lists separately. Type (lager) is correct; the name is wrong. Confirmed on 2022/2024 posters.
OYL-200 is Tropical IPA (non-flocculent Sacch, tart tropical mango/pineapple). Kolsch I is OYL-017, which our dataset already has correctly. Confirmed on the Tropical IPA product page.
OYL-203 is Brettanomyces Lambicus (horsey/cherry-pie funk). Type (brett) is correct but the name 'Hefe Weizen' is wrong. Confirmed on the 2022 Probrew poster.
OYL-400 is Bananza (Omega original, ripe banana esters, non-phenolic ale). Not 'American Lager'. Type (ale) is correct; the name is wrong. Confirmed on the Bananza product page.

OYL-500 is Saisonstein (Omega original saison hybrid of French OYL-026 and Belgian OYL-027). Belgian Ale A is OYL-024, which our dataset already has correctly. Type (ale) is correct; the name is wrong. Confirmed on 2022/2024 posters.
